name: Nathan Jones
profile: Co-founded the club in Aug 2024 and served as President from Aug 2024 to Oct 2026, when Valentine Mohaugen took over. Signed the original Constitution (Apr 29, 2025) and Revision 1 (Oct 30, 2025) as President. Quantathon Director on the SC Quantathon v3 committee (Aug 2025 – Sep 2026), and Student Advisor to the v4 committee since Oct 2026. Computer Science Ph.D. Candidate and Clemson Alumnus; research in Quantum Machine Learning, Variational Quantum Algorithms, and High Performance Computing.

name: Ashton McEntarffer
profile: Secretary from Oct 2025 to May 2026, and Interim Treasurer over the same months after Evan Hall stepped down; signed Constitution Revision 1 (Oct 30, 2025) in both roles. Handed the Treasurer role to Jack Layton in May 2026. Senior in Computer Science as of May 2026.

name: Evan Hall
profile: Co-founded the club in Aug 2024 and served as Treasurer from Aug 2024 to Oct 2025; signed the original Constitution (Apr 29, 2025) as Treasurer. Ashton McEntarffer took over as Interim Treasurer in Oct 2025 (Constitution Revision 1). Math Ph.D. Candidate and Clemson Alumnus; research in Quantum Error Correction.
